sigma_rules.author: Janantha Marasinghe

strategies.name: Detection Strategy for Hidden Virtual Instance Execution

analytics.name: Analytic 0909
analytics.guidance: Unusual execution of virtualization binaries (VBoxManage.exe, vmware-vmx.exe, vmwp.exe) with headless or suppressed notification arguments. Registry and service modifications linked to virtualization installs. Defender view: anomalies in process creation, service metadata, and registry writes tied to enabling hidden VMs.

tuning.description: Exclude known administrative VM software usage in enterprise environments.
Correlate registry and service modifications with VM process starts within a narrow time frame.

analytics.name: Analytic 0910
analytics.guidance: Execution of QEMU, KVM, or VirtualBox processes with unusual flags (e.g., '-nographic', '-snapshot'). File creation of VM images in atypical directories. Defender view: monitoring audit logs for process executions and file modifications linked to hidden virtualization.

tuning.description: Legitimate VM image storage paths to reduce false positives.
Correlate suspicious VM execution with non-admin or service accounts.

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: execve calls for qemu-system*, kvm, or VBoxHeadless

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: File creations of *.qcow2, *.vdi, *.vmdk outside standard VM directories

analytics.name: Analytic 0911
analytics.guidance: Execution of virtualization binaries (Parallels, VMware Fusion, VirtualBox) with arguments to hide UI. File monitoring for plist modifications indicating hidden virtualization behavior. Defender perspective: tracking process lineage and file modifications in system configs.

tuning.description: Focus monitoring on UI suppression or VM auto-run keys.

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Process execution for VBoxHeadless, prl_vm_app, vmware-vmx

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Plist modifications containing virtualization run configurations

analytics.name: Analytic 0912
analytics.guidance: Direct execution of /bin/vmx or presence of rogue .vmx files not registered in vCenter inventory. Defender perspective: anomalous commands in shell history, edits to rc.local.d/local.sh for persistence.

tuning.description: Cross-verify running VMs with vCenter inventory for rogue instances.

log_sources.name: esxi:vmkernel
log_sources.channel: VMX startup messages without associated vCenter inventory records
